static_traits.name: Zhang Manshan
static_traits.family_status: 与配偶共同生活,Has two children
static_traits.social_status: 与同事与家人的关系因Anxiety和易怒而一度紧张;Has a supportive spouse
static_traits.medical_history: without重大身体疾病;此前not yet出现类似心理问题;without既往心理治疗或辅导经历
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰,能进行自我Reflection;配合度高(Positive attitude);叙述中倾向关注负面并忽视正面;情绪Anxiety显著

basic_info.main_problem: 我一直有'因为我not再像以前那样反应迅速,我会失去在亚马逊的Work'的想法.几个月前在难以达到新的生产力目标时开始出现;这些想法让我在Work中Anxiety与overwhelmed,担心被解雇,几乎每天在Work或面对新任务时都会出现.
basic_info.core_demands: 我决定现在寻求咨询,因为这些想法已经开始影响我的Work表现和整体身心健康,而我已without法独自处理这种Anxiety.
growth_experiences: 几个月前,公司设定了新的生产力目标,Zhang Manshan在达标方面遇到困难,自觉速度not如以往;随后在Work中频繁出现灾难化的Work丢失担忧,尤其在面对新任务或高强度批次时加剧;该体验逐步影响到她的Work表现(错误增多,Decreased efficiency),与同事和家人的关系(因Anxiety与易怒而紧张),以及生活作息(Sleep affected与家庭任务专注度下降).上季度曾因'注意细节'收到正面反馈,但她往往忽视这类积极证据.

core_beliefs: I am not competent enough,终将被淘汰
My worth depends on speed and youth

special_situations.event: After the company sets new productivity goals, finds them hard to meet
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果达not到新目标,就说明我not够快,是负担,迟早会被解雇
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Doubles efforts to increase speed and efficiency, putting all energy on 'faster'

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能立刻适应新任务并保持高速,就会被认为not称职
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 在任务前后not断Self-monitoring与紧张加速,试图避免错误
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will definitely mess up; the supervisor will notice and then fire me

special_situations.event: 处理新的批次时跟not上节奏,担心主管注意到我的慢
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the supervisor sees my slowness, they will think I am a drag on the team
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 忽视自己在细节上的优势,盲目追求速度以掩盖not安
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: The supervisor will decide to let me go

special_situations.event: Compares speed with colleagues and worries that age factors will make the company prefer younger employees
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not如年轻同事快,公司就not需要我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 把速度作为唯一衡量标准,快速negate正面反馈与其他长处

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and retained, gaining stable job security and a sense of worth
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被评判为without能,Being rejected与被解雇(被淘汰)
defense_goal: Maintains control and safety through harsh self-blame and internalizing standards as high demands
保持对速度与产出指标的过度关注以避免被negate

object_relations.self_representation: not够快,可能拖团队后腿的员工
object_relations.object_representation: A judgmental supervisor or company focused only on speed, which could fire him at any time

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When supervisors or colleagues emphasize output speed, or new tasks/new batches appear
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 潜意识里将他人视为只会用速度评判并随时淘汰自己的权威者(移情:将被评判/被negate的Fear投到他人)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以Empathy且探询的语气回应,先验证Anxiety感受,再温和Clarification事实与证据;use开放式问题区分事实与推测,避免对抗与评判.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When self-evaluation falls into the state of 'either fast enough or a failure'
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Understanding oneself and work performance in all-good/all-bad terms, ignoring the middle ground and other value dimensions
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气稳定,具体化地邀请其寻找灰色地带与例外证据;use对比与具体事例来重建连续谱,避免贴标签式语言.

manifestations: The company's new productivity targets make them experience strong constraint from external norms, and the subjective sense of control decreases
When facing new tasks, worry about being fired intensifies; self-worth is excessively tied to speed and age
在Work情境中感到Restricted choices与责任压力,难以容纳not确定性

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Treats 'speed' as the only correct evaluation standard (I must be faster)
Internalizes company-set indicators as absolute requirements, ignoring one's other strengths

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection, involving excessive self-restriction and self-reproach, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 在任务前后not断自查速度与错误,紧张加速
快速negate积极反馈与优势(注意细节,问题解决)

exception_events.target_problem: 在面对新任务或高强度批次时,来访者通常会灾难化地预测被解雇,Anxiety飙升并导致出错与Decreased efficiency.
exception_events.unique_outcome: 上季度因'注意细节'获得了正面反馈,Work贡献在非速度维度上得到认可,显示其并非如担忧般'not可取'.
exception_events.reason: Clue: the supervisor and team also value quality and detail; the client's years of experience and familiarity with the processes brought stable quality performance, so this time an affirmed outcome emerged.

positive_force: Attention to detail, problem-solving ability, and familiarity with procedures
Has experience supporting colleagues (can help colleagues answer questions)
Has a supportive spouse,愿意Listening与陪伴
Willing to seek professional help and accept cognitive restructuring (positive attitude)
negative_force: 灾难化,预测not yet来,个人化,非黑即白等认知歪曲
Overly binds self-worth to speed and age
Highly sensitive to external evaluation,倾向negate积极反馈(寻求外部验证)
Anxiety导致睡眠与Impaired concentration,Relationship tension,从而进一步削弱绩效

target_behavior.behavior: 在Work场景中出现的强烈Anxiety与Catastrophizing(尤其面对新任务或新批次),伴随错误增多与Decreased efficiency
antecedent: The company setting and emphasizing new productivity targets
Being assigned new tasks or new batches appearing
Worries the supervisor will notice their 'slowness'
target_behavior.core_reason: 将自我价值与速度和年龄高度绑定,形成'若not够快就会被解雇'的信念,并以灾难化,预测not yet来,个人化,非黑即白等认知模式InterpretationWork情境.
target_behavior.function: 试图通过过度担忧与加速来获取控制与避免失败/被解雇的潜在风险(负Reinforcement:用紧张与Self-monitoring来逃避被视为without能的可能).
target_behavior.consequence: Anxiety intensified,错误增多,Decreased efficiency,进一步恶化Work表现并加剧对被解雇的Fear;影响睡眠与家庭/同事关系.
